meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Ran 7 Marathons in 7 Days on 7 Continents, I Climbed An 85ft Cliff With Only 1 Week of Training, I Trained Like A Victoria's Secret Model for 5 Weeks, I Tried Air Traffic Control, I Trained Like a NASA Astronaut
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
